description: This file implements a set of functions and classes for interacting with Feishu Drive via the Lark SDK, including comment management, file operations, and tool registration for a plugin API.

classes.name: FeishuReplyCommentError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling errors during Feishu comment replies, including HTTP and Feishu-specific error details.

methods.name: getDriveInternalClient
methods.description: Casts a Lark.Client to a FeishuDriveInternalClient with additional properties.

methods.name: encodeQuery
methods.description: Encodes a record of parameters into a URL query string.

methods.name: readString
methods.description: Safely reads a string value from an unknown type.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-null object.

methods.name: extractCommentElementText
methods.description: Extracts text content from a comment element object.

methods.name: extractReplyText
methods.description: Extracts text from a comment reply object.

methods.name: buildReplyElements
methods.description: Builds reply elements array for comment reply content.

methods.name: requestDriveApi
methods.description: Performs an API request to Feishu Drive with timeout and type safety.

methods.name: assertDriveApiSuccess
methods.description: Checks API response code for success, throws error otherwise.

methods.name: normalizeCommentReply
methods.description: Normalizes raw reply data into a structured format.

methods.name: normalizeCommentCard
methods.description: Normalizes raw comment card data into a structured format.

methods.name: normalizeCommentPageSize
methods.description: Ensures page size is within valid bounds for API requests.

methods.name: resolveAmbientCommentTarget
methods.description: Resolves comment target from context if channel is 'feishu'.

methods.name: applyAmbientCommentDefaults
methods.description: Applies ambient comment target defaults to parameters.

methods.name: applyAddCommentAmbientDefaults
methods.description: Applies ambient defaults for adding comments.

methods.name: applyAddCommentDefaults
methods.description: Ensures default file_type for adding comments.

methods.name: applyCommentFileTypeDefault
methods.description: Sets default file_type for comment actions if missing.

methods.name: formatDriveApiError
methods.description: Formats API error into a readable string.

methods.name: extractDriveApiErrorMeta
methods.description: Extracts detailed error metadata from API error object.

methods.name: isReplyNotAllowedError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a specific reply-not-allowed error.

methods.name: getRootFolderToken
methods.description: Fetches the root folder token via API call.

methods.name: listFolder
methods.description: Lists files in a folder, with optional token.

methods.name: getFileInfo
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info for a specific file.

methods.name: createFolder
methods.description: Creates a new folder, resolving root token if needed.

methods.name: moveFile
methods.description: Moves a file to a specified folder.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a specified file.

methods.name: listComments
methods.description: Lists comments on a file.

methods.name: listCommentReplies
methods.description: Lists replies to a comment.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Adds a new comment to a file.

methods.name: queryCommentById
methods.description: Fetches comment metadata by ID via batch query.

methods.name: replyComment
methods.description: Replies to a comment.

methods.name: deliverCommentThreadText
methods.description: Decides whether to reply or add a comment based on context and error handling.

methods.name: registerFeishuDriveTools
methods.description: Registers Feishu Drive related tools into the plugin API, with configuration checks.
